stage: Stage 05 - Manual balancing versus pressure-independent valves
result_kind: 24 steady network solutions; 0-1 s export is not a physical transient or control response
qualification: Generic ideal PICV envelope and assumed pump/device maps; numerical verification only, not vendor prediction or physical validation
picv_law: q/q_target=min(1,sqrt(max(dp,0)/35000 Pa)); adiabatic, zero reverse flow
picv_limitations: Ideal flow-limiting plateau has no manufacturing/control error
No actuator, diaphragm, sensor or controller dynamics
35 kPa minimum and 5 kPa reserve are study choices, not a fitted catalog selection
414 kPa upper-envelope guard; no case exceeds it
Real catalog +/-5% setpoint accuracy can exceed the small-change flow differences here
pump_policy: Fixed: retain each technology's own commissioned speed. Reset: independently calculate new steady speed; cap at 100%. No time-domain pump controller is simulated. Manual valve settings remain fixed in every case.
filter_reference_note: 20 kPa was already an assumed dirty-filter allowance in Stage 03; this study increases that coefficient to 25 or 40 kPa at the same nominal total flow. Not measured clean/dirty curves.
warnings_retained: The model contains alias variables with redundant start and/or conflicting nominal values. It is recommended to resolve the conflicts, because otherwise the system could be hard to solve. To print the conflicting alias sets and the chosen candidates please use -d=aliasConflicts.
